22: function EllesmereUI._RegisterSearchEntry(label, labelLoc, tooltip, moduleFolder, page, sectionName, selectorSetter, selectorKey, isSection)
23:     -- Opt-out for whole UI regions: a builder sets this around widget
24:     -- construction it wants excluded from the search entirely (e.g. the QoL
25:     -- Macro Factory, whose rows must never be indexed or deep-linked).
26:     if EllesmereUI._searchIndexSuppress then return end
27:     -- Composite labels (DualRow/TripleRow with an empty slot) can come in as whitespace
28:     -- only (e.g. a single joining space with nothing on either side) -- trim before the
29:     -- emptiness check so those don't register as inert, unmatchable junk entries.
30:     if label then label = label:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
31:     if not label or label == "" or not moduleFolder or not page then return end
32:     local key = moduleFolder .. "\1" .. page .. "\1" .. label
33:     if _seenKeys[key] then return end
34:     _seenKeys[key] = true
35:     _searchIndex[#_searchIndex + 1] = {
36:         label = label,
37:         labelLoc = labelLoc,
38:         tooltip = tooltip,
39:         module = moduleFolder,
40:         section = sectionName,
41:         page = page,
42:         -- Present only for entries built while a page's own internal selector (CDM bar
43:         -- / action bar / unit dropdown) was set to a specific value -- lets
44:         -- JumpToResult restore that exact selection before navigating, so a setting
45:         -- that only exists under one selector value (e.g. HoverCast-only options) is
46:         -- actually there to find and highlight instead of silently not matching.
47:         selectorSetter = selectorSetter,
48:         selectorKey = selectorKey,
49:         -- True for SectionHeader registrations: results render these as
50:         -- "Section: Title Case" destinations instead of option rows.
51:         isSection = isSection,
52:     }
53: end

5565: function EllesmereUI:EnsureLoaded()
5566:     if self._deferredLoaded then return end
5567:     -- Unlock core first (position/anchor engine), matching the pre-split order
5568:     -- where UnlockMode's deferred body ran before Widgets'.
5569:     self:EnsureUnlockCore()
5570:     -- Load the options addon: its files append their deferred inits, which the
5571:     -- loop below then runs. On failure keep _deferredLoaded false so a later
5572:     -- open retries after the user re-enables the addon.
5573:     if not EllesmereUI.EnsureOptionsLoaded() then return end
5574:     self._deferredLoaded = true
5575:     for i, fn in ipairs(self._deferredInits) do
5576:         fn()
5577:         self._deferredInits[i] = nil
5578:     end
5579: end

9316: function EllesmereUI:NavigateToElementSettings(moduleName, pageName, sectionName, preSelectFn, highlightText)
9317:     -- For split rows (DualRow etc.), narrow a deep-link highlight to the half/slot whose own
9318:     -- label matches instead of pulsing the whole row; returns that child region, or nil to fall
9319:     -- back to the full row. Inline, not a file-scope local: the main chunk is at the 200-local cap.
9320:     local function ResolveHighlightSlot(row, text)
9321:         if not text or not row.GetChildren then return nil end
9322:         local locText = EllesmereUI.L and EllesmereUI.L(text) or text
9323:         for _, region in ipairs({ row:GetChildren() }) do
9324:             local lbl = region._label
9325:             if lbl and lbl.GetText then
9326:                 local t = lbl:GetText()
9327:                 if t and t ~= "" and (t:find(text, 1, true) or (locText ~= text and t:find(locText, 1, true))) then
9328:                     return region
9329:                 end
9330:             end
9331:         end
9332:         return nil
9333:     end
9334: 
9335:     -- First-open split (see _SplitFirstOpen): Show() below returns without
9336:     -- building the panel on the session's first open, so run the whole deep
9337:     -- link next frame rather than navigating a panel that does not exist yet.
9338:     if self:_SplitFirstOpen(function()
9339:         EllesmereUI:NavigateToElementSettings(moduleName, pageName, sectionName, preSelectFn, highlightText)
9340:     end) then return end
9341: 
9342:     self:Show()
9343:     self:SelectModule(moduleName)
9344:     self:SelectPage(pageName)
9345: 
9346:     -- Switch dropdown AFTER the page is loaded, then force a full rebuild.
9347:     -- This mirrors exactly what the dropdown's own onChange handler does.
9348:     if preSelectFn then
9349:         preSelectFn()
9350:         self:InvalidateContentHeaderCache()
9351:         local config = modules[moduleName]
9352:         if config and config.getHeaderBuilder then
9353:             local hb = config.getHeaderBuilder(pageName)
9354:             if hb then self:SetContentHeader(hb) end
9355:         end
9356:         self:RefreshPage(true)
9357:     end
9358: 
9359:     C_Timer.After(0.05, function()
9360:         local cacheKey = moduleName .. "::" .. pageName
9361:         local cached = _pageCache[cacheKey]
9362:         if not cached or not cached.wrapper then return end
9363: 
9364:         local sections = CollectAllChildren(cached.wrapper)
9365:         for _, sec in ipairs(sections) do
9366:             if sec.header._sectionName == sectionName then
9367:                 -- Find the row to scroll to; narrow the highlight to the matching
9368:                 -- slot (DualRow half) when possible, otherwise pulse the whole row.
9369:                 local target = sec.header
9370:                 local hlTarget = sec.header
9371:                 if highlightText then
9372:                     for _, m in ipairs(sec.members) do
9373:                         if (m._labelText and m._labelText:find(highlightText, 1, true))
9374:                            or (m._labelTextLoc and m._labelTextLoc:find(highlightText, 1, true)) then
9375:                             target = m
9376:                             hlTarget = ResolveHighlightSlot(m, highlightText) or m
9377:                             break
9378:                         end
9379:                     end
9380:                 end
9381: 
9382:                 local a = target._origAnchor
9383:                 if a then
9384:                     local scrollPos = math.abs(a[5]) - 40
9385:                     EllesmereUI.SmoothScrollTo(scrollPos)
9386:                     C_Timer.After(0.15, function()
9387:                         local hl = GetSearchHighlight()
9388:                         PlaySearchHighlight(hl, hlTarget)
9389:                     end)
9390:                 end
9391:                 return
9392:             end
9393:         end
9394:     end)
9395: end
